SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT state FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[sessions] WHERE phone = '{{ $json.phone }}'), 'NO_SESSION') AS state,
    (SELECT container_number FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[sessions] WHERE phone = '{{ $json.phone }}') AS container_number,
    (SELECT container_type FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[sessions] WHERE phone = '{{ $json.phone }}') AS container_type,
    (SELECT last_deal_number FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[sessions] WHERE phone = '{{ $json.phone }}') AS last_deal_number,
    (SELECT last_deal_container FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[sessions] WHERE phone = '{{ $json.phone }}') AS last_deal_container

UPDATE [BotDb].[dbo].[sessions]
SET state = 'MENU_SENT'
WHERE phone = '{{ $('Determine Route').first().json.phone }}'

INSERT INTO [BotDb].[dbo].[sessions] (phone, state)
VALUES ('{{ $json.phone }}', 'MENU_SENT')

UPDATE [BotDb].[dbo].[sessions]
SET state = 'TRACKING_MENU_SENT'
WHERE phone = '{{ $json.phone }}'

UPDATE [BotDb].[dbo].[sessions]
SET state = 'AWAITING_CONTAINER'
WHERE phone = '{{ $json.phone }}'

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'NOT_FOUND'
    ELSE 'FOUND'
  END AS status,
  MAX(v.entry_date) AS entry_date,
  CASE WHEN MAX(v.declaration_number) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(v.declaration_number) <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_customs,
  MAX(v.escort_received_at) AS livoi_date,
  MAX(v.exit_date) AS exit_date,
  MAX(CASE WHEN o.is_owner = 1 THEN s.cnt END) AS sibling_count,
  MAX(o.is_owner) AS is_owner
FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[v_terminal_cargo] v
CROSS JOIN (SELECT hp, role FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[user_roles] WHERE phone = '{{ $('Determine Route').first().json.phone }}' AND is_active = 1) u
CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE
  WHEN u.role = 'customs_broker' THEN CASE WHEN v.release_order_customer_id = u.hp OR v.broker_code = u.hp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  WHEN u.role IN ('shipping_agent', 'forwarder') THEN CASE WHEN v.declarant_customer_id = u.hp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ELSE 0
END AS is_owner) o
CROSS APPLY (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v2.container_number) AS cnt
  FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[v_terminal_cargo] v2
  WHERE v2.handling_type = 'HH' AND v2.package_kind = 'CON'
    AND LEFT(v2.deal_number, 16) = LEFT(v.deal_number, 16)
    AND v2.container_number <> v.container_number
) s
WHERE v.container_number = '{{ String($json.body || '').replaceAll("'", "''") }}'
AND v.logistic_approval <> 1
AND v.handling_type = 'HH'
AND v.package_kind = 'CON'
AND v.status_code <> 'D'

UPDATE [BotDb].[dbo].[sessions]
SET state = 'AWAITING_CONTAINER_EMPTY'
WHERE phone = '{{ $json.phone }}'

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'NOT_FOUND'
    ELSE 'FOUND'
  END AS status,
  MAX(v.escort_received_at) AS livoi_date,
  MAX(v.entry_date) AS entry_date,
  MAX(v.rk_date) AS rk_date,
  MAX(v.exit_date) AS exit_date,
  MAX(o.is_primary) AS is_primary,
  MAX(o.is_owner) AS is_owner,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.forwarder_master_id = u.hp THEN v.deal_number END) AS own_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.package_kind <> 'CON' THEN v.deal_number END) AS total_count
FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[v_terminal_cargo] v
CROSS JOIN (SELECT hp, role FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[user_roles] WHERE phone = '{{ $('Determine Route').first().json.phone }}' AND is_active = 1) u
CROSS APPLY (SELECT
  CASE WHEN u.role = 'forwarder' THEN CASE WHEN v.container_owner_agent_id = u.hp OR v.forwarder_master_id = u.hp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS is_owner,
  CASE WHEN u.role = 'forwarder' AND v.container_owner_agent_id = u.hp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_primary
) o
WHERE v.container_number = '{{ String($json.body || '').replaceAll("'", "''") }}'
AND v.logistic_approval <> 1
AND v.handling_type = 'PP'
AND (v.status_code <> 'D' OR v.status_code IS NULL)

UPDATE [BotDb].[dbo].[sessions]
SET state = 'EMPTY_RESULT_MENU_SENT', container_number = '{{ String($('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.body || '').replaceAll("'", "''") }}', container_type = 'PP'
WHERE phone = '{{ $('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.phone }}'

UPDATE [BotDb].[dbo].[sessions]
SET state = 'AWAITING_DEAL_NUMBER_EMPTY'
WHERE phone = '{{ $json.phone }}'

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'NOT_FOUND'
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN o.is_owner = 1 THEN 1 END) = 0 THEN 'NOT_YOURS'
    ELSE 'FOUND'
  END AS status,
  MAX(CASE WHEN o.is_owner = 1 THEN v.qty_declared END) AS qty,
  MAX(CASE WHEN o.is_owner = 1 THEN v.weight_declared END) AS weight,
  CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN o.is_owner = 1 THEN v.declaration_number END) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(CASE WHEN o.is_owner = 1 THEN v.declaration_number END) <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_customs,
  CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN o.is_owner = 1 THEN v.has_escort END) = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_livoi,
  MAX(CASE WHEN o.is_owner = 1 THEN v.exit_date END) AS exit_date
FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[v_terminal_cargo] v
CROSS JOIN (SELECT hp FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[user_roles] WHERE phone = '{{ $('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.phone }}' AND is_active = 1) u
CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE WHEN v.forwarder_master_id = u.hp AND v.container_number = '{{ $('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.container_number }}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_owner) o
WHERE v.deal_number = '{{ String($json.body || '').replaceAll("'", "''") }}'
AND v.handling_type = 'PP'
AND v.logistic_approval <> 1
AND v.status_code <> 'D'

UPDATE [BotDb].[dbo].[sessions]
SET state = 'AWAITING_DECLARATION'
WHERE phone = '{{ $json.phone }}'

SELECT
  handling_type,
  Container,
  deal_number,
  MAX(entry_date) AS entry_date,
  CASE WHEN MAX(declaration_number) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(declaration_number) <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_customs,
  CASE WHEN MAX(has_escort) = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_livoi,
  MAX(exit_date) AS exit_date,
  MAX(qty_declared) AS qty,
  MAX(weight_declared) AS weight
FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[v_terminal_cargo]
WHERE declaration_number = '{{ String($json.body || '').replaceAll("'", "''") }}'
  AND logistic_approval <> 1
  AND status_code <> 'D'
AND (release_order_customer_id = (SELECT hp FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[user_roles] WHERE phone = '{{ $('Determine Route').first().json.phone }}' AND is_active = 1) OR broker_code = (SELECT hp FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[user_roles] WHERE phone = '{{ $('Determine Route').first().json.phone }}' AND is_active = 1))
GROUP BY handling_type, Container, deal_number
ORDER BY Container, deal_number

parameters.content:
NO_SESSION                          → new session, send main menu
MENU_SENT + "1"                     → send tracking submenu
MENU_SENT (other)                   → resend main menu

TRACKING_MENU_SENT + full_container     → ask for container # (מכולה מלאה)
TRACKING_MENU_SENT + empty_container    → ask for container # (מכולה ריקון)
TRACKING_MENU_SENT + declaration        → ask for הצהרה number
TRACKING_MENU_SENT (other)              → resend submenu

AWAITING_CONTAINER + back_to_menu       → main menu
AWAITING_CONTAINER + valid container#   → query מכולה מלאה
AWAITING_CONTAINER (invalid)            → invalid format msg

AWAITING_CONTAINER_EMPTY + back_to_menu → main menu
AWAITING_CONTAINER_EMPTY + valid #      → query מכולה ריקון
AWAITING_CONTAINER_EMPTY (invalid)      → invalid format msg

EMPTY_RESULT_MENU_SENT + empty_deal_number → ask deal number
EMPTY_RESULT_MENU_SENT + back_to_menu      → main menu
EMPTY_RESULT_MENU_SENT (other)             → main menu 


AWAITING_DEAL_NUMBER_EMPTY + back_to_menu → main menu
AWAITING_DEAL_NUMBER_EMPTY (other)        → query deal status
  (no format validation — not-found just reprompts, stays on this state)

AWAITING_DECLARATION + back_to_menu       → main menu
AWAITING_DECLARATION (other)              → query הצהרה contents

(no rule matched)                          → invalid format msg

SELECT
    MAX(scan_booked_at) AS scan_booked,
    MAX(scan_in_at) AS in_date,
    MAX(scan_out_at) AS ex_date
FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[v_terminal_cargo] v
CROSS JOIN (SELECT hp, role FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[user_roles] WHERE phone = '{{ $('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.phone }}' AND is_active = 1) u
WHERE v.container_number = '{{ $('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.container_number }}'
AND v.logistic_approval <> 1
AND v.handling_type = 'HH'
AND v.package_kind = 'CON'
AND v.status_code <> 'D'
AND (
  (u.role = 'customs_broker' AND (v.release_order_customer_id = u.hp OR v.broker_code = u.hp))
  OR (u.role IN ('shipping_agent', 'forwarder') AND v.declarant_customer_id = u.hp)
)

SELECT
    MAX(customs_registered_at) AS customs_registered
FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[v_terminal_cargo] v
CROSS JOIN (SELECT hp, role FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[user_roles] WHERE phone = '{{ $('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.phone }}' AND is_active = 1) u
WHERE v.container_number = '{{ $('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.container_number }}'
AND v.logistic_approval <> 1
AND v.handling_type = 'HH'
AND v.package_kind = 'CON'
AND v.status_code <> 'D'
AND (
  (u.role = 'customs_broker' AND (v.release_order_customer_id = u.hp OR v.broker_code = u.hp))
  OR (u.role IN ('shipping_agent', 'forwarder') AND v.declarant_customer_id = u.hp)
)

SELECT role FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[user_roles]
WHERE phone = '{{ $('Determine Route').first().json.phone }}' AND is_active = 1

SELECT ur.role, ur.name,
  (SELECT TOP 1 c.short_name_he
   FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[customers] c
   WHERE c.customer_id = ur.hp
     AND c.client_type = CASE ur.role
       WHEN 'shipping_agent' THEN N'סוכן אוניה'
       WHEN 'forwarder' THEN N'משלח'
       WHEN 'customs_broker' THEN N'עמיל מכס'
     END
  ) AS company_name,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[user_roles] WHERE phone = '{{ $('Determine Route').first().json.phone }}') AS role_count
FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[user_roles] ur
WHERE ur.phone = '{{ $('Determine Route').first().json.phone }}' AND ur.is_active = 1

UPDATE [BotDb].[dbo].[sessions]
SET state = 'AWAITING_DEAL_NUMBER_CARGO'
WHERE phone = '{{ $json.phone }}'

SELECT
  v.deal_number AS deal_number,
  MAX(v.qty_declared) AS qty,
  MAX(v.weight_declared) AS weight,
  CASE WHEN MAX(v.declaration_number) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(v.declaration_number) <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_customs,
  CASE WHEN MAX(v.has_escort) = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_livoi,
  MAX(v.exit_date) AS exit_date,
  MAX(CASE WHEN v.release_order_customer_id = u.hp OR v.broker_code = u.hp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_owner
FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[v_terminal_cargo] v
CROSS JOIN (SELECT hp FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[user_roles] WHERE phone = '{{ $('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.phone }}' AND is_active = 1) u
WHERE LEFT(v.deal_number, 16) = '{{ String($json.body || '').replaceAll("'", "''") }}'
AND v.handling_type = 'PP'
AND v.logistic_approval <> 1
AND v.status_code <> 'D'
GROUP BY v.deal_number

UPDATE [BotDb].[dbo].[sessions]
SET last_deal_number = '{{ String($('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.body || '').replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
    last_deal_container = {{ $('Determine Route').first().json.route === 'DEAL_NUMBER_EMPTY_SUBMITTED' ? "'" + $('Determine Route').first().json.container_number + "'" : 'NULL' }}
WHERE phone = '{{ $('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.phone }}'

SELECT
  v.deal_number AS deal_number,
  v.qty_declared AS qty,
  v.weight_declared AS weight,
  CASE WHEN v.declaration_number IS NOT NULL AND v.declaration_number <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_customs,
  CASE WHEN v.has_escort = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_livoi,
  v.exit_date AS exit_date
FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[v_terminal_cargo] v
CROSS JOIN (SELECT hp FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[user_roles] WHERE phone = '{{ $('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.phone }}' AND is_active = 1) u
WHERE v.container_number = '{{ $('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.container_number }}'
AND v.forwarder_master_id = u.hp
AND v.handling_type = 'PP'
AND v.logistic_approval <> 1
AND v.status_code <> 'D'

SELECT
  v.container_number AS container_number,
  v.entry_date AS entry_date,
  v.exit_date AS exit_date,
  v.escort_received_at AS livoi_date,
  v.scan_booked_at AS scan_booked,
  v.scan_in_at AS in_date,
  v.scan_out_at AS ex_date,
  v.customs_registered_at AS customs_registered
FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[v_terminal_cargo] v
CROSS JOIN (SELECT hp, role FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[user_roles] WHERE phone = '{{ $('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.phone }}' AND is_active = 1) u
WHERE v.handling_type = 'HH'
AND v.package_kind = 'CON'
AND v.logistic_approval <> 1
AND v.status_code <> 'D'
AND v.container_number <> '{{ $('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.container_number }}'
AND LEFT(v.deal_number, 16) = (
  SELECT LEFT(v2.deal_number, 16)
  FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[v_terminal_cargo] v2
  WHERE v2.container_number = '{{ $('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.container_number }}'
    AND v2.handling_type = 'HH' AND v2.package_kind = 'CON'
)
AND (
  (u.role = 'customs_broker' AND (v.release_order_customer_id = u.hp OR v.broker_code = u.hp))
  OR (u.role IN ('shipping_agent', 'forwarder') AND v.declarant_customer_id = u.hp)
)

UPDATE [BotDb].[dbo].[sessions]
SET state = 'AWAITING_ROLE_SWITCH'
WHERE phone = '{{ $('Determine Route').first().json.phone }}'

SELECT role FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[user_roles]
WHERE phone = '{{ $('Determine Route').first().json.phone }}' AND is_active = 0

UPDATE [BotDb].[dbo].[user_roles]
SET is_active = CASE WHEN role = '{{ String($json.body || '').replaceAll("'", "''") }}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
WHERE phone = '{{ $('Determine Route').first().json.phone }}'

DELETE FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[user_roles] WHERE phone = '{{ $('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.phone }}';
DELETE FROM [BotDb].[dbo].[sessions] WHERE phone = '{{ $('Main Router (Route Switch)').item.json.phone }}';
